description:
Jo SeungHoon is a newbie salaryman working at a game company for the past year. He is sent to the Human Resources Department, to work under a boss who's a devil in human disguise. The company grows quickly, but there is a hidden side to this growth. What is the devil's true goal, and how will the people respond once they have realized it?  
(Source: Hour of Lunacy)
